steps: Assess air quality for particulate matter assessment & diagnostics using monitoring data and emissions inventory

treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — air quality index compliance using EPA AQI monitoring network. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — air quality index compliance measured daily. Target: AQI <100 for 95% of days. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against EPA NAAQS standards. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — air quality index compliance trending toward AQI <50 for 80% of days. Escalate if <AQI <100 for 85% floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using EPA NAAQS framework. Report to Air Quality Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a atmospheric science and air quality specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign.
